;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[October 2020 Afghanistan attacks]]
***[[Taliban insurgency]]
****The [[Taliban]] kills at least six security forces and injures two others in [[Nimruz Province]]. [https://tolonews.com/afghanistan-167277 (TOLOnews)]
***At least nine people are killed and another one injured after two bombs explode in [[Ghazni]], [[Ghazni District]], [[Ghazni Province]]. [https://tolonews.com/afghanistan-167279 (TOLOnews)]
***[[October 2020 Kabul suicide bombing]]
****A [[suicide bomb]]ing kills at least 24 people and injures another 48 in [[Kabul]]. The [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant – Khorasan Province|Islamic State]] claims responsibility for the attack. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-54676319 (BBC News)]
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**A [[United States]] [[drone strike]] kills 17 members of [[al-Qaeda]] in [[Idlib]], including eleven leaders. Five civilians were also killed. [https://www.military.com/daily-news/2020/10/24/us-drone-strike-kills-17-jihadists-nw-syria.html (Military News)]
*[[Anglophone Crisis]]
**[[Kumba school massacre]]
***A [[mass shooting]] [[school shooting|at a school]] in [[Kumba, Cameroon|Kumba]], [[Southwest Region (Cameroon)|Southwest]], [[Cameroon]] kills at least six children and wounds eight others in an attack apparently committed by [[Ambazonia]]n [[separatist]] [[insurgent]]s. The [[United Nations]] office reports eight children were killed. A spokesman for the separatist movement expresses "shock and disgust" over the attack. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-cameroon-security/gunmen-storm-school-in-cameroon-killing-at-least-six-children-idUSKBN2790IR?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Two pilots are killed after a [[United States Navy|U.S. Navy]] [[T-6B Texan II]] [[trainer aircraft]] crashes in [[Alabama]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/navy-training-plane-crashes-alabama-neighborhood-killing-2-pilots-n1244634 (NBC News)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Austria]]
****The number of new infections in [[Austria]] rises by a record of 3,614 cases, pushing the total confirmed cases to 79,770 cases. [https://www.todayonline.com/world/austrian-coronavirus-cases-rise-record-3614-infections (''Today Online'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Belgium]]
****The [[Brussels]] [[Politics and government of the Brussels-Capital Region|regional government]], headed by its [[Minister-President of the Brussels-Capital Region|minister-president]] [[Rudi Vervoort]], orders sports and cultural facilities to close and imposes a curfew lasting between 10:00 p.m. and 6:00 a.m. local time. In addition, masks once again become mandatory in public spaces, shops must close at 8:00 p.m. local time, and public gatherings of more than four people are banned. The measures will last until November 19. [https://www.brusselstimes.com/brussels-2/137465/covid-19-in-brussels-extended-curfew-culture-in-lockdown-shop-sport-mask-cultural-venue/ (''The Brussels Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bulgaria]]
****[[Sofia]]'s mayor [[Yordanka Fandakova]] announces that it will close nightclubs and discos tomorrow for two weeks in an attempt to contain the spread of [[COVID-19]]. She also urges universities to switch to online education and appeals to businesses to have as many employees work from home as possible. [https://bnr.bg/en/post/101362147/nights-clubs-in-sofia-to-be-closed-for-two-weeks (BNR)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Czech Republic]]
****The number of new confirmed cases in the [[Czech Republic]] surpasses the 15,000 mark for the first time, when health authorities report a record of 15,252 new cases in a single day. [https://english.radio.cz/record-number-covid-19-infections-registered-friday-8698109 (Radio Prague)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****[[France]] reports 45,422 new cases of infections, the highest single-day spike in the country since the pandemic began, according to a statement from the [[Minister of Health (France)|Health Ministry]]. In turn, the total number of cases topped 1.08 million. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/europe/france-reports-over-45-000-new-virus-cases/2018129 (Anadolu Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****[[Germany]] surpasses 10,000 COVID-19 deaths, as the [[Robert Koch Institute]] reports a record 14,714 new cases in the last 24 hours. Germany is the twentieth country to surpass the 10,000 death milestone. [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/europe/germany-virus-death-toll-passes-10000 (''The Straits Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] reports a further record of 19,644 new coronavirus cases in the past 24 hours, as the [[Government of Italy|government]] considers further restrictions to contain a COVID-19 resurgence. [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/coronavirus/2020/10/24/Coronavirus-Coronavirus-Italy-plans-further-curbs-as-COVID-19-cases-hit-new-record (Al-Arabiya English)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Luxembourg]]
****[[Luxembourg]] reports a record 862 new infections in the past 24 hours, pushing the overall total to 13,713 cases as a [[curfew]] is introduced in the country. [https://today.rtl.lu/news/luxembourg/a/1601177.html (RTL Today)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Poland]]
****[[President of Poland|President]] [[Andrzej Duda]] tests positive for COVID-19. [https://www.dw.com/en/polish-president-andrzej-duda-tests-positive-for-coronavirus/a-55382241 (DW)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Portugal]]
****[[Portugal]] reports a record daily increase of 3,669 new cases, bringing the cumulative counts to 116,109 confirmed cases and 2,297 deaths. [https://covid19.min-saude.pt/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/236_DGS_boletim_20201024.pdf (DGS)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Slovakia]]
****[[Slovakia]] reports 2,890 new cases in the past 24 hours, the highest tally yet since the pandemic began, as the country launches an experimental testing program for its population. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-slovakia/slovakia-reports-2890-new-coronavirus-cases-highest-daily-tally-idUSL1N2HF07P (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****[[Jakarta]] surpasses 100,000 total COVID-19 cases, becoming the first province in [[Indonesia]] to reach that milestone. [https://www.beritasatu.com/jaja-suteja/kesehatan/690993/tembus-100000-kasus-positif-covid19-di-jakarta-lebih-banyak-dibanding-jepang (Berita Satu)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysia]] reports 1,228 new infections, a record daily jump since the start of the [[pandemic]], bringing the total number of cases to 25,742. Of those new cases, 449 of them are from [[Sabah]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/malaysia-reports-1228-new-covid-19-cases-biggest-daily-jump-13358706 (CNA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sri Lanka]]
****Authorities in [[Sri Lanka]] close at least two fishery harbours and many stalls after 609 COVID-19 cases are linked to the country's main fish market. [https://www.deccanherald.com/international/world-news-politics/sri-lanka-closes-2-harbours-after-609-coronavirus-positive-cases-906353.html (''Deccan Herald'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Chile]]
****[[Chile]] surpasses 500,000 cases of COVID-19, while active cases reach a record low of 9,900. [https://nationalpost.com/pmn/health-pmn/chile-surpasses-500000-confirmed-covid-19-cases (''National Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Colombia]]
****[[Colombia]] surpasses one million confirmed COVID-19 cases, becoming the second [[Latin America]]n country to surpass that milestone in less than a week. [https://apnews.com/article/virus-outbreak-bogota-caribbean-colombia-215bc8f8d603035e50c9934166c442e5 (AP)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Illinois]]
****[[Illinois]] reports 6,161 new cases, the most in one day since the [[pandemic]] began. [https://abc7chicago.com/health/more-than-6k-new-covid-19-cases-marks-highest-single-day-count-in-il/7305078/ (WLS-TV)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan]]
****[[Michigan]] reports 3,338 new cases, a new single-day record. [https://www.mlive.com/coronavirus/2020/10/michigan-reports-3338-new-coronavirus-cases-35-new-deaths.html (MLive.com)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Mexico]]
****[[New Mexico]] reports a record high of 875 new cases in a single day, bringing the statewide total to 41,040. [https://www.santafenewmexican.com/news/coronavirus/new-mexico-sets-single-day-record-with-875-virus-cases/article_a09fffa4-1640-11eb-ad47-073951f66c73.html (''The Santa Fe New Mexican'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ohio]]
****The [[Ohio Department of Health]] reports 2,858 new cases in [[Ohio]] in the past 24 hours, a new single-day record, thus pushing the statewide total to 195,806. [https://www.wkbn.com/news/coronavirus-in-ohio-state-to-release-latest-covid-19-case-numbers-at-2-p-m-2/ (WKBN-TV)]

;Law and crime
*[[Domestic terrorism in the United States]]
**A report published three days earlier by the [[Center for Strategic and International Studies]] finds that [[white supremacist]] and other [[far-right]] groups have perpetrated a majority of [[domestic terrorist]] attacks and plots in the first eight months of 2020. It also notes a rise in [[terrorist]] incidents perpetrated by [[far-left]] groups, as well as a decrease in fatalities from domestic terrorist attacks during that same time period compared to recent years. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/far-right-groups-are-behind-most-us-terrorist-attacks-report-finds/ar-BB1am0ti?li=BBnb7Kz (''The New York Times'' via MSN)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Egyptian parliamentary election]]
**The first round of [[Elections in Egypt|parliamentary elections]] starts in [[Egypt]]. The election is under criticism as most candidates are aligned with the pro-government [[Nation's Future Party]], curbing the expectations for political change. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/10/24/egypt-votes-for-new-rubber-stamp-parliament (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Crisis in Venezuela during the Bolivarian Revolution]]
**Prominent opposition figure [[Leopoldo López]] leaves the Spanish [[embassy]] in [[Caracas]] and flees to Spain via [[Colombia]], according to his own party, which did not elaborate how he escaped from Venezuela. López had been at the embassy for over a year to avoid [[house arrest]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics/venezuelan-opposition-figure-lopez-abandons-caracas-refuge-to-flee-abroad-idUSKBN2790QW?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Sports
*[[2020 AFL season]]
**[[Richmond Football Club|Richmond]] defeats [[Geelong Football Club|Geelong]] by a 31-point margin in the [[2020 AFL Grand Final]] at [[The Gabba]] in [[Brisbane]]. [https://www.news.com.au/sport/afl/afl-grand-final-2020-live-geelong-vs-richmond-scores-updates/live-coverage/ddc7ee0333c911f17a5def87ef1df0c7 (News.com.au)]
